question.prompt:
Triangles \(ABC,\) \(ADE,\) and \(EFG\) are all equilateral. Points \(D\) and \(G\) are midpoints of \(\overline{AC}\) and \(\overline{AE},\) respectively. If \(AB = 4,\) what is the perimeter of figure \(ABCDEFG?\)

[Figure 1](figures/2000_AMC_8_Q15_question_fig1.svg)

solutions.explanation:
[Figure 1](figures/2000_AMC_8_Q15_question_fig1.svg)

Each equilateral triangle has three equal sides, and each midpoint halves a side. These facts let us work from the largest triangle to the smallest.

Since \(ABC\) is equilateral, \(AB=BC=AC=4\). Because \(D\) is the midpoint of \(AC\),
\[
AD=DC=2.
\]
Triangle \(ADE\) is equilateral, so \(AE=DE=2\). Because \(G\) is the midpoint of \(AE\), we have \(AG=GE=1\). Finally, triangle \(EFG\) is equilateral, giving \(EF=FG=1\).

Trace the outside boundary in the order \(A,B,C,D,E,F,G,A\). This includes each boundary segment exactly once and excludes the shared interior segments \(AD\) and \(EG\). Its perimeter is
\[
\begin{aligned}
P&=AB+BC+CD+DE+EF+FG+GA\\
 &=4+4+2+2+1+1+1=15.
\end{aligned}
\]
Thus the perimeter is \(\boxed{15}\), choice C.
solutions.title: Find and add the boundary lengths
